featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Heartfelt Thank You to Raising Right

As we prepare for a new chapter in our son Rihav’s life, we can’t help but look back with immense gratitude at the beautiful journey he has had with Raising Right. It feels like just yesterday when we walked through the doors, nervous yet hopeful, entrusting our little one to your care. And today, as he takes his next big step into a bigger school, our hearts are full of emotions—gratitude, nostalgia, and a little bit of bittersweet joy.

Raising Right has been more than just a school; it has been a second home for Rihav. The love, patience, and dedication of every teacher and staff member have shaped him in ways we could have never imagined. He has grown not just in knowledge but in confidence, kindness, and curiosity. The values instilled in him, the friendships he has built, and the countless happy moments he has experienced will always be cherished.

As parents, nothing is more reassuring than knowing your child is in safe and nurturing hands, and Raising Right gave us that peace of mind every single day. Thank you for laying such a strong foundation for Rihav’s future. Though we move ahead, Raising Right will always have a special place in our hearts.

With love and gratitude,
Rihav's Mumma ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Devani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled my child in this playgroup with high expectations, but unfortunately, the experience has been disappointing.
Firstly the location 📍 is not at all safe for school specially a preschool and lots of chaos, can’t even park your vehicle for few minutes as it’s a proper station road and market lane.
The overall management and communication with parents need significant improvement. The staff did not seem attentive enough, There is poor communication from management, when you ask for any queries. Half the time they will reply after few days or don’t even responds at all and you have to keep following for the things.

No PTM even once a year. Everything application based. How do we get our children’s update on progress or performance.  Sad 😔 (only through app)

Note : if you both are working parents then don’t even think of enrolling as the fees you paid to them are just used in maximum show off events and you and your child will not be able to attend 70% of events as their maximum events needs parent’s involvement.

Overall Very disappointing experience.

As parents, we trust schools to provide a nurturing and safe atmosphere, but I did not feel confident about that here.

No annual day for playgroups and sports day was done in some dead place were they invited more than 300 parents and only 50 aproxx chairs were put other parents were literally sitting down on grounds under direct sun so they don’t miss their 1 minute child’s performance- v badly organized.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and works on improving the quality of care and learning for children rather than putting funds in events which we can’t even attend.

I would not recommend this playgroup. 🙏🏻🙏🏻

Adding comments below after their reply.

My intention of putting this review was only to highlight few points which we already tried sharing personally & sharing our genuine feedback and concerns.

But your cover up reply and the way you responded as expected 😃
proved my messages right.  😃

Thank you  🙏🏻 🙏🏻
